phase_name: Wire the audit call into every creation surface

objectives.description: commands/task.md Create Task Mode + Expand Mode wiring
commands/errors.md Step 3.6 non-interactive wiring + escape valve
Fix audit-task-proposals.sh single-mode id:null bug (--id flag)
Update Current Compliance Status table to reflect actual wiring
Regenerate index-entries.json line counts for grown files

approaches_tried.approach: Interpreted plan's literal 'Stage 2.5 (Pre-Confirmation)' as a stage-number requirement in meta-interview.md
approaches_tried.reason: Stage 2.5 already names a different, pre-existing stage (DetectDomainType) in that file; the plan's phrasing was descriptive (functional intent: pre-confirmation, foreground), not a literal stage-number citation -- used the fractional-numbering convention already established (2.5/3.5/4.5 exist) to add a new Stage 4.6, placed right before the confirmation gate where the task list is actually stable

approaches_tried.approach: First draft of the Backlog Reconciliation Check in commands/task.md and commands/review.md's single-proposal audit-task-proposals.sh calls omitted --id
approaches_tried.reason: audit-task-proposals.sh's single-flag mode hardcoded id: null with no flag to set it, so state-write.sh's --audit-verdict matching (keyed on proposal.id == new entry's project_name) could never find a covering entry for ANY single-mode caller -- added a new --id CORRELATION_ID flag to the script (Phase 3 scope, fixed here since the gap only surfaced once a real single-mode caller was wired) and threaded --id "$slug" through both call sites

approaches_tried.approach: Wiring commands/errors.md's audit call without reconciling /task's own interactive Step 5.5
approaches_tried.reason: errors.md explicitly states 'no user gate and no AskUserQuestion' as a design invariant, but /task's new Step 5.5 would introduce exactly that when /errors delegates task creation to a literal /task invocation at its own Step 4 -- added a non-interactive escape valve to /task's Step 5.5 (skip audit re-run and skip AskUserQuestion when a caller has already set $backlog_audit) and had /errors' new Step 3.6 pre-resolve and export that variable per task before each /task hand-off

deviations.reason: skill-meta/SKILL.md delegates ALL interview logic (including the existing Component 4a overlap check) to context/workflows/meta-interview.md, executed inline -- the real call site for Component 4b belongs there too, for the same reason. Placed as a new 'Interview Stage 4.6: BacklogReconciliation' (interactive mode) and 'Step 4.5' (prompt mode), immediately before each mode's confirmation step, since the proposed task list is only stable post-consolidation. SKILL.md itself gained a delegation-context JSON field (backlog_audit_result) rather than a literal script call, mirroring how Component 4a appears there (one passing mention, not the implementation).
